description: This file contains functions for establishing and managing a MongoDB connection using Mongoose, including connection setup, retrieving the database instance, and obtaining collections. It also sets up event listeners for connection events and handles environment-based configuration.

methods.name: connectDB
methods.description: Establishes a connection to MongoDB using Mongoose, with environment-based configuration and event logging.

methods.name: getDb
methods.description: Returns an active MongoDB database instance, establishing a connection if necessary.

methods.name: getCollection
methods.description: Retrieves a MongoDB collection by name or list of candidate names, returning the first existing collection or defaulting to the first candidate.
